clips.title: The story
paras: Xavian lies in northeastern Ashenvale, where satyrs have claimed an ancient night elf temple. It is their chief seat in the forest, and they use its ruins for dark rites that spread demonic corruption through the woodland.

Xavian lies in Ashenvale's northeastern hills, west of Forest Song and north of Satyrnaar. Satyrs hold the ruined temple, once sacred to the night elves, and make it their chief stronghold in the forest. Their leaders, including Prince Raze and Geltharis, direct their followers from its desecrated arches and terraces. Across the grounds, satyrs perform rites against the woodland and use stolen Warsong oil to blight it. The place bears the name of Xavius, a highborne councilor who became the first satyr during the War of the Ancients after failing Sargeras.
